items.title: Iola Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Wilton, CT, July 17, 2011
items.q: We had Louis Armstrong and his band, and Paul wasn’t in it but Dave and Joe and Eugene.

ctx.x: That’s wonderful. And probably mounting this co-production, trying to get it on Broadway, I can’t imagine the hoops that you’d have to.

Well it never came about. Jimmy Lyons at the Monterey Jazz Festival telephoned us. We had moved to Connecticut by that time, and said “I want you do to it in Monterey.” Well of course it’s not a situation where you can mount a musical in Monterey. And so I decided okay, we’ll do it as a concert version with narration of most of the songs. So we had Louis Armstrong and his band, and Paul wasn’t in it but Dave and Joe and Eugene. And Lambert, Hendricks and Bavan, Annie had left by that time. And it was a super hit…
Wow. And to put it on in an outdoor venue like that I mean — to go across — that’s great.
